== Notes ==
* Only the base damage from attacks is reduced, the bonus damage of [[attack skill]] and damage caused by skills is not. 
** Very useful for [[Assassin]]s in [[PvP]], as most of their damage comes from [[attack skill]] bonus damage, which isn't reduced by Flurry.
** Most common stance for [[IW mesmer]]s, since [[Illusionary Weaponry]] ignores Flurry's damage reduction.
* Heroes don't seem to use this skill.
{{bug|Contrary to the description, the 25% damage reduction only applies to base damage.}}
